scope.summary: Build the archetype/recipe browser panel per Section 13.27 GUI clauses: thumbnail grid of BRC- recipes with tags, one-click apply, and layer/region-scoped blend (partial apply) — the seeded ARCH-A..ARCH-H recipes visible and appliable, surfacing the MT-605 'take her breasts, keep my face' flow in the UI.
acceptance_criteria: The browser lists BRC- recipes with thumbnails (from CAP- captures), names, tags, and layer badges (shape/skin/genitals/physics); seeded ARCH-A..ARCH-H appear with their archetype tags.
Apply loads the full recipe onto the current draft via the recipe lane; a viewport capture before/after proves the application changed the body.

Blend/partial-apply UI selects a source recipe plus a region or layer scope and applies only that scope — the browser exposes the take-her-breasts-keep-my-face flow with direct labeling, no euphemisms.
Import of a PNG recipe card (MT-606) via drag/drop or file picker lands the recipe in the browser with dependency warnings surfaced.
All controls carry stable author_ids; Argus can drive browse -> apply -> capture headlessly.
scope.risk_if_missed: Recipes exist only as API objects invisible to the operator, so the fastest authoring workflow (start from an archetype, blend regions) never enters daily use and the archetype QA bodies stay developer-only artifacts.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: BodyKit GUI must expose or integrate the geometry/morph, joint, weight/rigidity, transfer, skin/material, interlink, Jobs, Problems, history, recovery, and shared-world contracts.
